free_tier.stated: Per-second metered GPU rental with an unusual funding ladder, from the vendor's own price document: no top-up allows 1 instance with 1 card; a top-up under 100 allows 3 instances with 1 card each; a top-up of 100 or more allows 3 instances with no per-instance card limit. Billing is per second and settled hourly, with a one-hour charge frozen at creation. Each instance carries 50 GB of initial space at /hy-tmp, with extra space at CNY 0.0004 per GB-hour. A third-party directory lists an east-China RTX 4090 at CNY 2.00/hour and marks the vendor 免实名 (no real-name check) with Alipay and WeChat accepted.
